articles.title: Penguin India says ‘Four Stars of Destiny’ unpublished, threatens legal action over circulating copies
articles.summary: Penguin Random House India issued a clarification affirming its exclusive publishing rights for 'Four Stars of Destiny,' the forthcoming memoir by a former Indian Army Chief. This statement ensures the highly anticipated book, expected to offer valuable insights into military leadership and strategic decision-making, will proceed under their sole authority, addressing any potential disputes.

articles.title: Villarreal move above Atletico Madrid after extending miserable 2026 for Espanyol
articles.summary: A Monday night football fixture at La Ceramica featured two teams, close in table positions but separated by an eight-point gap. This significant difference in their league standing became apparent during the match, demonstrating that on-paper proximity didn't reflect actual performance. The game highlighted the true disparity between the sides.

articles.title: NOGIG 2026: Teams get wins in table tennis, volleyball
articles.summary: The 20th Nigeria Oil and Gas Industry Games have commenced, witnessing strong starts from major energy companies. NNPC and TotalEnergies secured impressive victories in volleyball, while Aradel and NLNG dominated in table tennis. This multi-sport event brings together participants from Nigeria's vital oil and gas sector, fostering camaraderie and healthy competition among industry giants in various disciplines.

articles.title: Airtel expands reach amid growing data consumption
articles.summary: Airtel Nigeria is significantly expanding its fibre, 4G, and 5G network infrastructure to meet the nation's rapidly growing demand for mobile and internet services. This crucial technological upgrade reflects the increasing importance of robust digital connectivity for national development and economic growth, a vital consideration for aspiring leaders.

articles.title: Markiplier Confirms IRON LUNG Home Release Is Imminent and Still 100% Independent "From Start to Finish"
articles.summary: The indie sci-fi horror film 'Iron Lung', which enjoyed a surprisingly strong theatrical run, is soon set for an at-home release. This highly anticipated move will make the critically acclaimed movie more accessible to a wider audience. Its unique blend of science fiction and horror elements has garnered significant attention, making its creator's continued involvement crucial for its successful digital launch.

articles.title: 3D-printed military structures dot the Himalayas
articles.summary: The Trishakti Corps of the Indian Army has successfully deployed a 3D-printed underground tunnel at an altitude of 16,000 feet in Sikkim. This innovative use of additive manufacturing demonstrates the Army's adoption of cutting-edge technology for tactical infrastructure in challenging high-altitude terrains. Such advancements enhance operational capabilities, provide strategic advantages, and signify a forward-thinking approach to modern military engineering and defence readiness.

articles.title: Astronomers close in on long-lost Soviet lunar lander
articles.summary: For nearly 60 years, the Soviet Union's Luna 9, the first humanmade object to successfully land on the moon, has been missing. Researchers are now closer to locating this historic spacecraft. Its potential discovery offers significant insights for space archaeology and early lunar missions, reflecting persistent efforts to retrieve valuable data and artifacts from humanity's pioneering ventures into space.
